Class Screen

java.lang.Object
java.awt.Component
java.awt.Canvas
awtzero.Screen
All Implemented Interfaces:
ImageObserver, MenuContainer, Serializable, Accessible
public class Screen extends Canvas
Provides a drawable screen area using double buffering to reduce flickering.
